31.name: Night Ferry
31.why: A small boat crossing dark water with a lantern lit, steered by someone who means well.

31.name: Moonless Sea
31.why: The deep water under no moon, where a wooden sailor keeps watch without being asked.

31.name: Small Hours
31.why: The hours after midnight, when I wake and walk the corridor to make sure the child is safe.

32.name: Gingerbread
32.why: The brown of something baked slowly on a winter evening, the smell of a toymaker's kitchen.

32.name: Old Varnish
32.why: The glow of a wooden toy loved for years and rubbed to a shine by small hands.

32.name: Puppet Wood
32.why: The carved wood of the puppets who play out their lives beneath the old clock tower in Tbilisi.
